social.a_recovery_code_exists_if_this_pc: A recovery code exists. If this PC ever loses its key it uses its saved copy by itself; a new code replaces both.
social.add_an_account_first_codes_are_ma: Add an account first; codes are made by signed-in players.
social.also_talk_with_simple_voice_chat_: Also talk with Simple Voice Chat players
social.an_offline_name_is_tied_to_a_secr: An offline name is tied to a secret key kept on the PC where it was first used. This PC doesn't have that key (a new PC, a reinstall, or a wiped Arctic folder). If you made a recovery code before (Friends, Recovery code), enter it below. If you never did, ask in the Arctic Discord to have the name released.
social.choose_what_friends_see_online_st: Choose what friends see: online status, the server you play on, invites, your name
social.close_that_game_first_it_saves_it: Close that game first; it saves its own settings when it quits.
social.codes_are_kept_on_the_arctic_serv: Codes are kept on the Arctic server; text and files work anywhere.
social.copied_friends_paste_it_into_impo: Copied. Friends paste it into Import (Instances tab) or run `arctic import`.
social.copied_paste_it_anywhere_it_works: Copied. Paste it anywhere; it works without the server.
social.could_not_create_your_invite_key: Could not create your invite key: {e}
social.couldnt_reach_modrinth_to_look_th: Couldn't reach Modrinth to look the other mods up.
social.everyone_needs_the_same_minecraft: Everyone needs the same Minecraft version and mods. Connections are direct between your PCs when possible, and relayed (still encrypted) when not.
social.friends_can_see_when_im_online: Friends can see when I'm online
social.friends_follow_you_on_too_skip_to: Friends follow you on {username} too. Skip to keep it separate.
social.hear_and_be_heard_only_by_your_fr: Hear and be heard only by your friends.
social.hold_v_in_game_to_talk_change_it_: Hold V in game to talk (change it in the Arctic menu → Voice).
social.invite_friends_into_your_world_no: Invite friends into your world. No server and no port forwarding.
social.isnt_on_modrinth_so_its_left_out_: {f} isn't on Modrinth, so it's left out; send it separately.
social.it_becomes_a_new_instance_the_exa: It becomes a new instance; the exact same mod versions are downloaded from Modrinth.
social.leave_empty_to_find_the_lan_world: Leave empty to find the LAN world automatically.
social.link_your_discord_to_get_this_pro: Link your Discord to get this profile back, with its friends, on another PC.
social.looking_up_mod_files_on_modrinth: Looking up {count} mod files on Modrinth…
social.lower_picks_up_quieter_speech_and: Lower picks up quieter speech (and more background noise).
social.no_friends_yet_add_someone_by_the: No friends yet. Add someone by their friend code (or a Microsoft account's name); they need to use Arctic too.
social.off_friends_see_only_your_profile: Off: friends see only your profile name, so alts stay private.
social.offline_accounts_belong_to_this_p: Offline accounts belong to this PC. Arctic makes a code on its own at the next sign-in and keeps it on this PC; make one here to see it and move to another PC.
Offline accounts belong to this PC. Make a code to move them to another one.
social.on_servers_that_run_the_simple_vo: On servers that run the Simple Voice Chat plugin, connect to it too, so players using that mod hear you and you hear them. Not with "Only friends".
social.open_multiplayer_the_world_is_lis: Open Multiplayer. The world is listed under the LAN section.
social.or_if_you_linked_your_discord: Or, if you linked your Discord:
social.paste_a_code_like_abcd_efgh_or_sh: Paste a code (like abcd-efgh) or share text, or open a .json file.
social.paste_the_invite_code_your_friend: Paste the invite code your friend sent you.
social.pick_a_version_on_the_play_tab_fi: Pick a version on the Play tab first.
social.press_esc_choose_open_to_lan_then: Press Esc, choose Open to LAN, then Start LAN World.
social.save_it_somewhere_safe_its_shown_: Save it somewhere safe: it's shown only this once. On a new PC, add the same offline name and enter it to bring this profile and its friends back.
social.send_your_friends_the_invite_code: Send your friends the invite code.
social.servers_you_add_in_minecraft_or_f: Servers you add in Minecraft (or from Discover) show up here with who's online.
social.settings_instances_as_mod_lists_a: Settings, instances (as mod lists) and client settings. Never accounts or passwords.
social.show_friends_all_my_linked_accoun: Show friends all my linked accounts
social.start_minecraft_same_version_as_y: Start Minecraft (same version as your friend).
social.start_the_game_in_a_duel_arena_an: Start the game in a duel arena and invite {name}
social.talk_with_other_arctic_players_ne: Talk with other Arctic players near you on the same server: voices get quieter with distance and come from where the player stands. Audio goes directly between players; the Arctic server only tells launchers who else is on that server.
social.that_port_isnt_a_number_from_1_to: That port isn't a number from 1 to 65535.
social.the_world_now_shows_up_in_multipl: The world now shows up in Multiplayer.
social.these_become_your_default_game_se: These become your default game settings: every new instance starts with them. Your instances keep theirs.
social.this_profile_can_no_longer_be_res: This profile can no longer be restored with that Discord account
social.tick_at_least_one_thing_to_import: Tick at least one thing to import.
social.ticked_launcher_settings_replace_: Ticked launcher settings replace yours. Ticked instances are added; yours with the same names stay as they are.
social.type_their_friend_code_or_their_m: Type their friend code or their Microsoft account's name. They need to use Arctic too.
social.used_this_name_on_another_pc_ente: Used this name on another PC? Enter the recovery code you saved there.
social.waiting_for_a_world_in_game_press: Waiting for a world. In game, press Esc and choose Open to LAN.
social.you_made_one_before_a_new_one_rep: You made one before. A new one replaces it.
social.your_friend_code_give_it_to_peopl: Your friend code: give it to people so they can add you
social.your_server_list_couldnt_be_read: Your server list couldn't be read: {e}
